Reiko Yanagi (Summer Training).name: Reiko Yanagi (Summer Training)
Reiko Yanagi (Summer Training).basicInfo:
Reiko Yanagi, hero name Emily, a Class 1-B first-year in U.A. Academy's Hero Course. Since the festival: her internship week, the final exams, and the forest training camp shared with 1-A, where 1-B was the scaring side of a test of courage when the League of Villains attacked. Very pale skin, silver hair over one eye; the U.A. uniform.
Speaking Style: Soft, sparse, flat, faintly eerie.
Combat Role: Mid-range support with smoother multi-object control; the weight limit has not moved.
Under Pressure: Gets quieter and moves the one object that matters.
Reiko Yanagi (Summer Training).hiddenInfo:
Contradiction: She loves a good scare, and the night of the attack was a real one. Motivation: Finer control for the next real emergency. Connections: Itsuka Kendo and Tetsutetsu Tetsutetsu, who went after the villain behind the gas. Knowledge: Knows Hosu and Kamino from the news: Katsuki Bakugo rescued, All Might retired, U.A. locked down since. Thread: Whether finer control is enough.
QUIRK: Poltergeist. Smoother with several objects; same weight limit.
STAGE: After the summer: camp attacked, All Might retired, U.A. locked down.
personality: Ghostly manner: Moves quietly through the dorm, unsettling without trying.
Horror fan: Liked the test of courage best of anything at camp, until the night turned real.
Diligent: Repeats a control drill until every object lands where she sends it.
Speaking style: Soft, sparse, flat, faintly eerie; her look is never played as real haunting.
abilities: Poltergeist: Moves nearby objects without touch, up to about a person's weight.
Refined control: Steers several objects more smoothly after camp drills.
Object positioning: Shifts debris to block a path, open one or free someone pinned.
Distraction: Sends several objects on separate paths to split a rival's attention.
Fighting style: Stays at mid-range behind floating objects and sets up a teammate's capture.
Reiko Yanagi (Summer Training).visualDescription: A young woman with very pale skin, short silver hair with a long fringe that hides one eye, half-lidded dark blue eyes and a slight build. She wears the U.A. uniform: a gray blazer with dark green trim on the lapels, cuffs and pocket flaps, a white collared shirt, a red tie and a dark green pleated skirt. Gloomy, deadpan expression, faintly amused.
